notes.title: New version is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42599890/4cb6c436573af416c801b2e64c50c4b14d9a02e5.png[/img]

Hi!

Thank you again for waiting for so long.
The latest update is finally here and it's adding plenty of new sounds and visuals.

Most importantly, there's a new UI allowing for browsing the generative artworks. Each combination of music and 3D visuals is unique, and defined by a single ID visible in the bottom-right corner. 
It's like browsing from an almost infinite selection of music loops with their own audio visualizers.

And here's a more detailed list of the main changes:
[list]
[*] Now featuring 5 full audio-visual scenes
[*] New interface for browsing the generative variations
[*] Visuals and sounds now are connected together
[*] Introducing IDs for saving and sharing specific combinations
[*] Updated audio reactive mode - now supporting system audio and microphone inputs
[*] Auto-saving state of each scene
[*] Simplified visual settings
[*] And many more performance and usability fixes
[/list]

Feel free to share any feedback over here or via social media.
Thanks!
